# Ordo display-topology fixture (T0.5). Blank lines and lines starting with
# `#` are ignored. One record per line, fields separated by whitespace:
#   operator <id> <x> <y> <width> <height>      the display carrying the operator
#   congregation <id> <x> <y> <width> <height>  the assigned congregation display
#   display <id> <x> <y> <width> <height>       any other connected display
#   expect <direction|none>                     locator direction from congregation
#                                               back to the operator display
# Bounds are logical pixels in the OS virtual desktop; <direction> is a
# platform::display::RelativeDirection variant name.
# Primary projector at the origin; the operator laptop sits to its right.

operator 1 1920 0 1366 768
expect Right
